preferredStudio: Isolated local Qwen runner supplies a frozen WAV to ComfyUI native audio nodes; Voicebox remains optional
speaker: Ryan
identity: Warm clear male voice, calm and lightly dry-humored. Same speaker and model across all lines.
deliveryPolicy: Write natural complete phrases. Give each phrase a performance direction separate from spoken text. Generate two takes for important hooks. Preserve breaths and pauses; do not force all lines into the same duration.

directions.hook: Ask with genuine curiosity, a slight upward inflection, then pause briefly. Speak to one person; no announcer voice.
directions.dryHumor: Understate the punchline with a small smile in the voice and a short pause before the reveal.
directions.proof: Explain clearly and matter-of-factly, slowing slightly on the key distinction. No exaggerated enthusiasm.
directions.cta: Give a relaxed helpful invitation, with a gentle falling cadence. No sales shout.

approvalScope: User approved the 14.56-second chair take: Keep this voice and delivery. Longer expressive consistency remains to be tested.

draftOnlyBackend.speaker: am_michael
draftOnlyBackend.use: Timing and pronunciation audition, never silently substituted for production.

uniqueVoiceOption: Qwen VoiceDesign -> approved synthetic reference -> reusable Base clone prompt. This is a different path from CustomVoice and does not have the same documented per-line instruct controls; audition expressive range before switching.
audioPipeline: Generate and approve dialogue first. Freeze clean WAV and settings hashes. Condition LTX on clean approved audio for visible speech. The room scene can apply its versioned room-audio profile at export; preserve timing and source bytes and save the processed waveform hash separately. Review room sound together with lip sync.
auditionCriteria: Same timbre across hook, explanation, dry humor and CTA
Natural phrase stress, breathing and pauses
Exact words; no repetitions or invented speech
No clipped syllables or unnatural joins
Stable voice across a 60-90 second sample
